indexing_validation: h10 C++ SubIndices port checked against all fixture path nodes and color_indices_10_2.txt; h24/h27 reuse the same port with range checks

stage_definitions.index_ms: per-leaf path_nodes_for_leaf plus map_indices_for_leaf; excludes h10 fixture load/validation and expected-entry setup
stage_definitions.query_serialize_ms: uncompressed expanded query ciphertext serialization after decode, outside query and server timing
stage_definitions.server_first_dimension_ms: sum over PIR servers of process_first_dimension_delayed_mod
stage_definitions.server_second_dimension_ms: sum over PIR servers of process_second_dimension or passthrough for 2D
stage_definitions.server_last_dimension_ms: sum over PIR servers of process_last_dimension
stage_definitions.server_ms: full BatchPIRServer generate_response wall time including stages and merge
stage_definitions.response_serialize_ms: SEAL Ciphertext::save to uncompressed in-memory streams, outside server and decode timers
stage_definitions.decode_ms: client decode_responses_chunks only; correctness comparison happens after this timer

communication_size_labels.query: seeded save_size/2 model plus separately measured actual unseeded ciphertext payload; these are different encodings
communication_size_labels.helper_keys: actual GaloisKeys and RelinKeys save bytes, uncompressed, once per session
communication_size_labels.response: actual bytes returned by Ciphertext::save(compr_mode_type::none) to in-memory streams

serialization_timing: query and response save uncompressed in memory, outside server timing
